title: Three equivalent conditions for a finitely presented closed subscheme of the source of an almost blowup square to contain the relevant pieces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given an almost blowup square and a closed immersion W -> X' of finite presentation, the lemma proves the equivalence of three conditions: that X' setminus E is scheme theoretically contained in W, that the blowup X'' of X in Z is scheme theoretically contained in W, and that the restricted square with E cap W and W is again an almost blowup square (statement lines 11026-11044). The proof is a cycle of implications: from (1) the surjection O_{X'} -> O_W is an isomorphism over the open complement of E, and since the ideal sheaf of X'' in X' is by definition the sheaf of sections of O_{X'} supported on E, this forces (2); (2) implies (3) directly from the definitions; and (3) implies (1) because X'' cap (X' setminus E) is isomorphic to X setminus Z, which is in turn isomorphic to X' setminus E (proof lines 11047-11054). Recognising that the defining property of an almost blowup square, the ideal sheaf supported on E, is exactly the bridge between conditions (1) and (2) is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
